title: The Sun
text_content:
The sun is a star.
It gives us light and heat.
Plants and people need the sun.
It shines during the day.

title: Dogs
text_content:
Dogs are animals.
They can be pets at home.
Dogs can run and bark.
They are known as loyal animals.

title: Water
text_content:
Water is very important.
People drink water every day.
Plants need water to grow.
Water has no color.

title: Birds
text_content:
Birds have wings and feathers.
They can fly in the sky.
Some birds build nests in trees.
They lay eggs.

title: The Moon
text_content:
The moon can be seen at night.
It shines in the sky.
The moon does not make its own light.
It reflects light from the sun.

title: Trees
text_content:
Trees are plants that grow tall.
They have roots, trunks, and leaves.
Trees give shade and fresh air.
Many animals live in trees.

title: Fish
text_content:
Fish live in water.
They use gills to breathe.
Fish have fins to swim.
They come in many colors.

title: Schools
text_content:
Schools are places for learning.
Students go there to study.
Teachers help students learn new things.
Schools have classrooms and books.

title: Rain
text_content:
Rain comes from clouds.
It falls as water drops.
Rain helps plants grow.
Too much rain can cause floods.

title: Bicycles
text_content:
A bicycle has two wheels.
People ride it to travel.
It is moved by pedaling.
Bicycles are good for exercise.

title: Fruits
text_content:
Fruits grow on plants and trees.
They are sweet and healthy to eat.
Fruits have vitamins.
Examples are apples, bananas, and mangoes.

title: The Earth
text_content:
The Earth is our home.
It has land and water.
People and animals live on Earth.
We must take care of it.

title: Air
text_content:
Air is all around us.
We cannot see it, but we can feel it.
People and animals need air to breathe.
Clean air is important for health.

title: Clothes
text_content:
People wear clothes every day.
Clothes protect our bodies.
We wear different clothes for different weather.
They also come in many styles and colors.

title: Transportation
text_content:
Transportation helps people move from one place to another.
Examples include cars, buses, and trains.
They make travel faster and easier.
Different places use different types of transportation.
